manifest.name: dsh-wallpaper
manifest.description: Photo wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: serves the DSH home's wallpaper folder as a full-window background and makes the theme surfaces translucent.

bundle.text:
# Enables the plugin when the bundle is installed.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-wallpaper
      name: dsh-wallpaper

readme.text:
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · **English**

A wallpaper plugin for **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)** — put a photo behind the whole GUI.

DeepSeek Harness ships three appearance modes (light / dark / follow system), and its theme tokens only carry colours — there is no wallpaper feature and no custom-CSS box. This plugin adds one: a real image behind the sidebar, the conversation and the composer, with the surfaces turned into translucent glass so the photo shows through.

Overlays, masks and modals (`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`, `--dsw-alias-bg-mask-*`) are deliberately left alone so dialogs stay readable.

Everything is wrapped in `try/catch`: a client entry that throws aborts the whole web boot and makes the desktop disable every third-party plugin, so this one must never throw.

Requires a DSH build with client-plugin support (the desktop app or `dsh web`), and a plugin profile — `desktop` by default.

Recommended: paste the prebuilt tarball URL into **Plugins → Add plugin**, or use the standard CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/fl0-0wer/dsh-wallpaper/releases/download/v1.1.1/dsh-wallpaper-1.1.1.tgz
```

Replace `desktop` if you use another profile. The package includes prebuilt client JavaScript, the bundle patch, and the default wallpaper; no local build is required.

Manual installation follows:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fl0-0wer/dsh-wallpaper.git
cd dsh-wallpaper
```

Copy the package into the profile and the settings into the wallpaper folder — `$DSH_HOME/wallpaper`, or `~/.dsh/wallpaper` when `DSH_HOME` is unset:

```bash
PROFILE="${DSH_PROFILE:-${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/desktop}"
WALL="${DSH_WALLPAPER_DIR:-${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/wallpaper}"
mkdir -p "$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-wallpaper" "$WALL"
cp -r package.json lib current.jpg cordis.patch.yml "$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-wallpaper/"

Then append this block to `$PROFILE/cordis.patch.yml` (or run `tools/install-wallpaper.sh`, which does all of the above and backs the file up first):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-wallpaper
      name: dsh-wallpaper
```

No restart needed: the loader hot-applies the new entry and the page picks the module up on its own.

Open **设置 → 背景壁纸** (Settings → Wallpaper): pick a photo with **选择图片…**, turn the wallpaper on or off, and drag the sliders. Every change is saved immediately and the running app repaints behind the panel — no restart, no reload.

Drop a photo into the wallpaper folder and point `config.json` at it:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "image": "my-photo.jpg",
  "scrim": 0.45,
Switch to another window and back — the plugin re-reads the settings whenever the window regains focus, and the image is cache-busted by its modification time, so no reload is required.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` removes the layer and the style, i.e. temporarily off |
| `image` | `current.jpg` | file name inside the wallpaper folder; without an extension it tries jpg → jpeg → png → webp → avif |
| `scrim` | `0.45` | black veil over the photo, 0–1. Raise it if text feels washed out |
| `blur` | `0` | blur radius in px, 8–24 gives a frosted look; above 0 the photo moves to a filtered layer |
| `saturation` | `1` | 0.6 for a muted look, 1.4 for punchier colours |
| `translucency` | `0.5` | how much of the photo comes through the UI surfaces; 0 = almost opaque, 1 = strongest |

The plugin ships two neutral palettes and switches on the theme's own `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` attribute, so it follows 设置 → 通用 → 外观 (light / dark / follow system) automatically. Accent colours, syntax highlighting, borders and text colours are untouched — only the surfaces change.

If you also run a glass theme (for example Catppuccin), the wallpaper takes over the surfaces; the theme keeps its accents and text palette.

1. Remove the `- insert: dsh-wallpaper` block from `$PROFILE/cordis.patch.yml`.
2. Delete `$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-wallpaper/`.

The wallpaper folder can stay where it is; it does nothing on its own.

```
dsh-wallpaper/
├── lib/index.js        host half: /dsh-wallpaper/* routes
├── lib/client.js       client half: style + layer + Settings page
├── config.json         default settings

`tools/install-wallpaper.sh` installs into a profile, `tools/toggle-wallpaper.py` unloads and reloads the entry so a changed `lib/` is picked up without restarting the app, and `tools/test-client.mjs` + `tools/test-host.mjs` are dependency-free smoke tests.
MIT

[English](README.md) · **简体中文**

给 **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)** 换一张图片背景的插件 —— 让整个界面后面铺一张照片。

DSH 的外观只有浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统三档，主题 token 也只承载颜色，既没有壁纸功能、也没有自定义 CSS 入口。这个插件补上这一块：侧栏、会话区、输入框后面会铺上图片，界面表面变成半透明玻璃，让照片透出来。

- **宿主半侧**（`lib/index.js`）在 DSH 的 web server 上注册一组接口：
  - `GET /dsh-wallpaper/config.json` —— 返回配置文件内容，附带图片的修改时间；
  - `GET /dsh-wallpaper/image` —— 返回图片本身（jpg / jpeg / png / webp / avif / gif / svg）；
  - `POST /dsh-wallpaper/config` —— 把补丁合并进配置（数值会被夹到合理区间）；
  - `POST /dsh-wallpaper/upload` —— 收下上传的照片（校验文件头，上限 40 MB）并把配置指向它。
- **客户端半侧**（`lib/client.js`）注入一个 `<style>`，把照片作为固定背景画在 `<html>` 上，再把五个表面 token 换成中性色板的半透明版本：
  `--dsw-alias-bg-base`、`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1`、`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-2`、`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-3`、`--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`。
  它还会注册**设置 → 背景壁纸**页面，全部操作都在界面里完成。

遮罩、模态框（`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`、`--dsw-alias-bg-mask-*`）刻意不动，保证弹窗始终可读。

所有代码都包在 `try/catch` 里：客户端入口一旦抛错会终止整个 web boot，桌面端会因此禁用**全部**第三方插件，所以这里不能有任何异常逃出去。

需要一个支持客户端插件（`dsh.client`）的 DSH 版本（桌面版或 `dsh web`），以及一个 profile —— 默认是 `desktop`。

推荐在「插件 → 添加插件」粘贴以下预构建包地址，或使用标准 CLI：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/fl0-0wer/dsh-wallpaper/releases/download/v1.1.1/dsh-wallpaper-1.1.1.tgz
```

如果使用其他 profile，把 `desktop` 替换为对应名称。此包已包含客户端 JavaScript、bundle patch 与默认壁纸，无需本地构建。

以下是手工安装方式：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fl0-0wer/dsh-wallpaper.git
cd dsh-wallpaper
```

把包复制进 profile、把配置复制到壁纸目录——`$DSH_HOME/wallpaper`，未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/wallpaper`：

```bash
PROFILE="${DSH_PROFILE:-${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/desktop}"
WALL="${DSH_WALLPAPER_DIR:-${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/wallpaper}"
mkdir -p "$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-wallpaper" "$WALL"
cp -r package.json lib current.jpg cordis.patch.yml "$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-wallpaper/"

然后往 `$PROFILE/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-wallpaper
      name: dsh-wallpaper
```

也可以直接跑 `tools/install-wallpaper.sh`，它会自动完成上面的复制并先备份 `cordis.patch.yml`。

不需要重启：loader 会热加载新条目，页面自己就会拿到这个模块。

打开**设置 → 背景壁纸**：点「选择图片…」挑一张照片，用「关闭壁纸 / 开启壁纸」控制开关，下面的滑杆调遮罩、透明度、模糊和饱和度。每改一次都会立刻保存并在界面后面重新上色 —— 不用重启，也不用刷新。

也可以直接把照片放进壁纸目录，然后修改 `config.json`：

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "image": "我的照片.jpg",
  "scrim": 0.45,

切到别的窗口再切回来即可 —— 窗口重新获得焦点时插件会重读配置，图片按修改时间自动换缓存，不用刷新页面。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 设为 `false` 会撤掉图层和样式，相当于临时关掉 |
| `image` | `current.jpg` | 壁纸目录里的文件名；不写扩展名时按 jpg → jpeg → png → webp → avif 依次查找 |
| `scrim` | `0.45` | 压在照片上的黑色遮罩，0–1；觉得字发散就调大 |
| `blur` | `0` | 模糊半径（px），8–24 是磨砂观感；大于 0 时改用带滤镜的固定图层 |
| `saturation` | `1` | 0.6 偏灰、1.4 更艳 |
| `translucency` | `0.5` | 界面表面透出照片的程度；0 = 几乎不透明，1 = 最透 |

插件内置中性色 / 白色两套色板，跟随主题自己的 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 属性切换，所以「设置 → 通用 → 外观」里的浅色、深色、跟随系统都能正常工作。强调色、代码高亮、边框、文字颜色都不受影响的，只有表面颜色被换掉。

如果你还装了玻璃质感主题（比如 Catppuccin），壁纸会接管表面颜色，主题的强调色和文字配色保持不变。

1. 删掉 `$PROFILE/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `- insert: dsh-wallpaper` 这一段。
2. 删除 `$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-wallpaper/`。

壁纸目录可以留在原处，它本身不会产生任何效果。

```
dsh-wallpaper/
├── lib/index.js        宿主半侧：/dsh-wallpaper/* 路由
├── lib/client.js       客户端半侧：注入样式、图层与设置页
├── config.json         默认配置

`tools/install-wallpaper.sh` 负责装进 profile，`tools/toggle-wallpaper.py` 可以卸载再加载这个条目，让改过的 `lib/` 立即生效而不重启应用，`tools/test-client.mjs` 与 `tools/test-host.mjs` 是不依赖第三方库的冒烟测试。
